rules.statement: The measure and each selected supplement run from 1 January through 31 December and continue automatically unless withdrawn; animals claimed for a category must fulfil its conditions throughout that period.

conditions.description: A measure category or supplement has been requested.

result.description: Only full-year compliant animals can participate.

rules.statement: At least 2.00 GVE across all requested pig categories is required at 1 April or as the annual average; it need not be met separately in every category.

conditions.description: Aggregate requested eligible animals are below the threshold.

result.description: The minimum participation condition is not met.

rules.statement: Eligible categories are piglets 8–32 kg, young and fattening pigs from 32 kg (including uncovered gilts and culled breeding animals), and breeding sows/covered gilts from 50 kg.

conditions.description: An animal category is declared in the payment request.

result.description: Only listed categories may receive the measure premium.

rules.statement: A farm holding more than 10.00 GVE of eligible pigs must participate in a recognised pig animal-health service for the full funding year and provide proof on request (in 2023, 15 April–31 December sufficed).

conditions.description: The holding exceeds the animal-health-service threshold.

result.description: Animal-health service participation is mandatory.

rules.statement: A regular stall needs a fixed building with at least three-sided cladding/wind-netting, roofed lying places and fixed floor; open systems require a fixed roof above lying places, liquid-tight fixed surfaces and drainage to a collection pit.

conditions.description: Participating animals are kept in a stall.

result.description: The recognised stall definition must be satisfied.

rules.statement: Group-stalled animals require a dry, bedded, planar lying area (at most 5% perforation), sufficient grass/straw/hay enrichment, and the per-animal total and lying areas in the applicable table.

conditions.description: A participating pen is evaluated.

result.description: Every pen, not a category average, must meet its space requirement.

rules.statement: Until and including application year 2024, a stall sketch and maximum-occupancy plan were required for each participating category and pen; from 2025 neither is required.

conditions.description: Historic application years through 2024 only.

result.description: The records are an historic requirement only.

rules.statement: Piglets, young/fattening pigs, breeding sows and covered gilts must be kept in groups. A sick or injured animal may be singly kept on bedding for at most 10 days with documented need; after 10 days it must be deregistered.

conditions.description: A participating animal is housed individually.

result.description: Health reason, duration and bedding determine eligibility.

rules.statement: Sow/gilt group requirements do not apply in statutory non-group periods. The pre-2013-stall transition window may be used only if the normal window cannot be met without construction; otherwise the normal 10-days-after-service window applies.

conditions.expression: sow or covered gilt outside statutory group period
conditions.description: The animal is in an allowed non-group interval.

result.description: Bedding and space measure conditions are also waived for that interval.

rules.statement: All animals in a requested category must generally participate. Where existing stalls prevent this, only animals continuously compliant from eligible weight through rearing end/slaughter (or continuously for the sow category) may be claimed; non-compliant animals must be deregistered.

conditions.expression: existing stall limits participation or an animal changes to non-compliant housing
conditions.description: Not all category animals comply continuously.

result.description: Others receive no premium.

rules.statement: Freeland pigs require the permit maximum stocking rate or, absent a fixed maximum, no more than 4 GVE/ha unpaved area; double fencing/dense enclosure, separated feed and water, roofed feed, suitable feed/water siting and a three-sided roofed bedded lying area for all animals are required.

conditions.description: Requested animals are held on unpaved freeland.

result.description: All structural and stocking conditions must be met.

rules.statement: Freeland use must be recorded continuously with start/end of grazing per parcel and animal number per parcel; an unpaved parcel may be used continuously as pig pasture for at most one year, and free-ranging wild boar are not eligible.

conditions.description: Requested animals use unpaved freeland.

result.description: Wild boar must be deregistered.

rules.statement: The uncut-tail supplement is available only for piglets and young/fattening pigs when every participating animal in the respective category has an uncut tail throughout the application year; it cannot be selected or withdrawn by individual animal or pen.

conditions.description: The uncut-tail supplement is requested.

result.description: All category animals must qualify.

rules.statement: The GMO-free European protein supplement requires exclusively GMO-free protein feed of European origin for all animals held on the farm throughout the calendar year; no nonconforming protein feed, including old stock, may be stored or fed, and purchased feed needs origin/GMO evidence.

conditions.description: The protein-feed supplement is requested.

result.description: Failure prevents the supplement.

rules.statement: From 2025, the manure-composting supplement requires all solid manure arising on farm, regardless of species, to be windrow-composted on farm and turned at least twice at intervals of at least 14 days with compliant equipment; specified mixed/layered organic windrows are accepted without turning.

conditions.description: The supplement is requested in an eligible year.

result.description: Compost-stall manure alone is not eligible.

rules.statement: The farm must document establishment and turning of compost windrows and compost application or transfer to third parties; nitrate action-programme rules remain applicable.

conditions.description: The manure-composting supplement is requested.

result.description: Documentation is a condition of the supplement.

rules.statement: If stall/freeland conditions cannot be met for individual or multiple animals, their annual-average count must be reported immediately in the Tierwohl Weide/Stallhaltung attachment; they receive no premium and the deregistration is annual.

conditions.expression: conditions cannot be met for claimed animal
conditions.description: Category compliance fails in the funding year.

result.description: Immediate AMA notification is required.

rules.statement: Categories and optional supplements must be requested in the measure application by 31 December before contract start; last entry to categories is funding year 2027 (application by 31 December 2026) and to supplements is 2028 (application by 31 December 2027).

conditions.description: A new contract is to be established.

result.description: Late ordinary application does not establish the following-year contract.

rules.statement: Animal numbers are declared at 1 April or, for variable stocks, as calendar-year average; corrections to the annual average are possible until expiry of the four-week objection period after the payment notice with movement evidence.

conditions.description: A 1-April snapshot would not represent stock.

result.description: Supporting access/departure records are required for correction.

rules.statement: If a category has no eligible animal in a funding year, that category's contract ends automatically; re-entry requires a new timely measure application.

conditions.description: No premium-eligible animal participates in the category.

result.description: Future participation needs a new application.

rules.statement: After completing the one-year contract, the whole measure, individual categories or supplements may be withdrawn. A withdrawal made during 1 January–31 December makes the measure invalid for that application year; withdrawal after fulfilled obligations starts on 1 January of the following year.

conditions.description: The farm wants to leave a category, supplement or measure.

result.description: Use the current multiple application online.

rules.statement: Eligible GVE equal claimed animal numbers from the animal list minus deregistered numbers, converted by the GVE table; annual rates vary by category, year and supplement.

conditions.description: Eligible animal data and application year are known.

result.description: Apply the data table rates to eligible GVE.

rules.statement: Funded animals must be kept in Austria; only domestic animals are countable in the animal list and premium-relevant livestock stock.

conditions.description: An animal is declared for funding.

result.description: Only Austrian-held animals count.

rules.statement: For a takeover of a livestock-related measure, animals and land must originate from the same previous farm.

conditions.description: A farm seeks to take over the animal-related measure.

result.description: A split-origin takeover does not satisfy the stated rule.
